selectionBasis: Selection basis: publicly documented relevant work and a plausible contribution to this agenda. “Remote task” is our suggested request, not an advertised opening unless explicitly noted. Willingness, capacity, affiliation with the movement and remote arrangements remain unconfirmed for every entry. Use institutional public routes; no personal activist contact database is included.

items.name: Association for Democratic Reforms / National Election Watch
items.documentedRelevance: Electoral and political transparency; public reports on candidates, funding and expenditure.
items.suggestedRemoteContribution: Review the electoral-accountability language and one public-data verification checklist.
items.status: Current reports establish relevant work; a current remote volunteer opportunity is not confirmed.

items.name: Internet Freedom Foundation (IFF)
items.documentedRelevance: Digital rights, privacy and freedom of expression; its volunteer page includes technology and design contributions.
items.suggestedRemoteContribution: Review the privacy/retaliation model; test an accessible synthetic intake or appeal interface.
items.status: Public volunteer invitation found; task acceptance and remote arrangements still need confirmation.

items.name: Software Freedom Law Center, India (SFLC.IN)
items.documentedRelevance: Digital-rights legal and policy work; public volunteer invitation.
items.suggestedRemoteContribution: Review surveillance, shutdown and platform-remedy descriptions; identify unsupported legal claims.
items.status: Public volunteer invitation found; no commitment to this project or legal representation.

items.documentedRelevance: RTI, government accountability, public entitlements, complaints and public hearings.
items.suggestedRemoteContribution: Stress-test the reasoned-response and refusal pathways using a consented anonymised case.
items.status: Mandate supports fit; remote availability not confirmed.

items.suggestedRemoteContribution: Review the public-hearing design so documents and software do not displace community testimony.
